title: Chiseled Mobs
description: A resource pack That Adds Mob Features to some of the chiseled blocks that don't have them
body:
A resource pack That Adds Mob Features to some of the chiseled blocks that don't have them.

current addtions:

Chiseled Stone Bricks - Enderman screaming

Chiseled Deepslate - Warden chest

Chiseled Tuff Bricks - Breeze eyes and eyebrows

Chiseled Tuff - Frog (I know it's not thematic, but I thought it was funny)

Chiseled Quartz - Ghast

Chiseled Copper - Top of the Copper Golem Lightning rod in the middle

Addional notes:

For consistancy, this pack contains the top textures for the of Chiseled blocks whether they have been modifed or not. (only the top of chiseled quarts has been modifed) This may mess with other pack you have installed if they change those textures.

This Pack _should_ work for versions below 1.21, I just listed it as 1.21.x and higher because thats when the Tuff Bricks were added.

You may put this in your modpacks as long as you credit me.
